speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned a longstanding pruritic rash with numbness and tingling on your palms; can you tell me if the rash appears as small, flat-topped bumps or a scaly patch, and does it affect the soles of your feet as well?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Based on your history of working on a rice farm and caring for livestock, do you suspect you might have been exposed to poison ivy, oak, or sumac (Toxicodendron species)? Also, has this rash spread to other parts of your body or appeared in specific patterns?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Leprosy (Hansen's disease).

The combination of hypopigmented macules on the elbows, loss of eyelashes and eyebrow thinning, along with the classic triad of pruritus, numbness, and tingling in the palms, is highly specific for this condition, especially given your history of agricultural exposure.
